column1: # The workflow runs the evidence pages cite whose outputs are kept past the 90 days GitHub keeps a
# run's artifacts (#2124). Each kept run's outputs are in a commit of their own that
# (tools/ci/keep-run-outputs.py says what it keeps; `kept` is taken from each commit's KEPT.md).
# A kept file reads as plain text at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DrunkOnJava/rvt-rs/<commit>/<path>,
# the form the pages' citations are to link to (Griffin, 2026-11-22). A run whose artifacts were
# gone before it could be kept has `-` for its commit and says why. These are the runs the five
# evidence pages cited on 2026-11-22; a run cited later is kept by dispatching the workflow on it.
# A row named `<run>-probes` or `<run>-holdout` is a commit beside the run's first, holding only its
# probes' own output (#2143) or its held-out models' summary counts (#2145, Griffin 2026-11-22); one
# named `<run>-summaries` holds the held-out and `rac_advanced` models' summary counts and export
# digests (#2148, Griffin 2026-11-27); one named `<run>-log` holds the lines of a run's log a pattern
# found, for figures it printed only there (#2148).
